title: Infused Intake Upgrade
text: Installed in a Crystal Ball, Resonant Crystal Ball or Cruise Orb, it harvests mature crops and collects dropped items within 8 blocks every 10 seconds. Ordinary blocks are not broken.

Right-click while holding it to configure three whitelist or blacklist samples. Filters match harvested and dropped items. Crops are not harvested without enough storage space; a seed is retained for regrowth.
Each adult cow provides one Milk Suspension per cycle, while sheep yield wool through normal shearing. Neither takes damage. Only eggs already laid by chickens are collected.
Sneak-right-click the installed Crystal Ball with an empty main hand to preview its 8-block range.
